description:
Julia And Tarkan is solely responsible for offering this listing on Airbnb, and they host as a business. For more legal information, visit our Help Center.

To help protect yourself from fraud, always use Airbnb to send money and communicate with hosts.
host_about:
We specialise in historic apartments with interior design magic that make memorable, comfortable, secure, short term homes for discerning international visitors - you!

Julia, Tarkan and our manager Taşkın are certified by the UK Institute of Hospitality.

We've been busy, building up a special collection of the best apartments in Galata, our favourite part of Istanbul. We've personally renovated most of them and stay in them ourselves whenever we can. Recently we've added a sweet property in England's Cotswolds to the mix.

20 years ago we met in Istanbul, Tarkan's home city, while Julia was there for a photography assignment. Since then we've led international lives together, based in Istanbul, Singapore and now England, Julia's original country. 

Along the way we've raised our son, Eren, across the cultures as we've steadily grown this holiday apartment project - our second baby. We see it as a way to find balance in our family life and to always have a home in our best-loved city.  

We understand from our own experiences, what makes a great city-break stay and try our very hardest to deliver it to you in Istanbul. For this we've won i-escape's global Guest Award for 'Best City Apartment' two years running and Tripadvisor's Certificate of Excellence every year from from 2016 to 2022.

We’re also listed in many guidebooks and have been featured in magazines for our interior design “hipstoric” flair. 

Your questions and booking will be handled by us. On arrival, manager Taşkın and friendly team  - with natural Turkish hospitality - will welcome you to your apartment, pass over the keys and explain practicalities and the neighborhood. You'll have as much or as little help as you choose and we're sure you'll soon feel at home in the cosmopolitan and very welcoming local community.

"Life is a balance of holding on and letting go" said Rumi, whose Mevlevihanesi for 'whirling dervishes' is just up the hill from our apartments in Galata. We agree... do you?!

name: Elegance and high quality with breezy sea views
description: A truly beautiful apartment on the 3rd floor of an elegant 19th-century building near Galata Tower. Stylish, spacious, bright and airy, with stunning views across *both* the Bosphorus and the Golden Horn - an incredibly rare combination. With a perfect balance of antique and contemporary furnishing - pure quality - guests often tell us they don’t want to leave. Located on Galata’s most sophisticated street, you’ll be surrounded by the area’s signature bohemian charm, cafés, and culture.
host_about:
We specialise in historic apartments with interior design magic that make memorable, comfortable, secure, short term homes for discerning international visitors - you!

Julia, Tarkan and our manager Taşkın are certified by the UK Institute of Hospitality.

We've been busy, building up a special collection of the best apartments in Galata, our favourite part of Istanbul. We've personally renovated most of them and stay in them ourselves whenever we can. Recently we've added a sweet property in England's Cotswolds to the mix.

20 years ago we met in Istanbul, Tarkan's home city, while Julia was there for a photography assignment. Since then we've led international lives together, based in Istanbul, Singapore and now England, Julia's original country. 

Along the way we've raised our son, Eren, across the cultures as we've steadily grown this holiday apartment project - our second baby. We see it as a way to find balance in our family life and to always have a home in our best-loved city.  

We understand from our own experiences, what makes a great city-break stay and try our very hardest to deliver it to you in Istanbul. For this we've won i-escape's global Guest Award for 'Best City Apartment' two years running and Tripadvisor's Certificate of Excellence every year from from 2016 to 2022.

We’re also listed in many guidebooks and have been featured in magazines for our interior design “hipstoric” flair. 

Your questions and booking will be handled by us. On arrival, manager Taşkın and friendly team  - with natural Turkish hospitality - will welcome you to your apartment, pass over the keys and explain practicalities and the neighborhood. You'll have as much or as little help as you choose and we're sure you'll soon feel at home in the cosmopolitan and very welcoming local community.

"Life is a balance of holding on and letting go" said Rumi, whose Mevlevihanesi for 'whirling dervishes' is just up the hill from our apartments in Galata. We agree... do you?!

name: Airy style, amazing terrace views in Galata!
description:
Our apartment is on the 2nd floor of a grand and elegant 19th century building very close to Galata Tower. It's stylish, spacious, graceful and airy, with stunning views right across the Golden Horn from the shared roof terrace a few floors up.

We also offer a selection of 'experiences' with our local guides, to help you build your own genuine and memorable perspective on the city.
host_about:
We specialise in historic apartments with interior design magic that make memorable, comfortable, secure, short term homes for discerning international visitors - you!

Julia, Tarkan and our manager Taşkın are certified by the UK Institute of Hospitality.

We've been busy, building up a special collection of the best apartments in Galata, our favourite part of Istanbul. We've personally renovated most of them and stay in them ourselves whenever we can. Recently we've added a sweet property in England's Cotswolds to the mix.

20 years ago we met in Istanbul, Tarkan's home city, while Julia was there for a photography assignment. Since then we've led international lives together, based in Istanbul, Singapore and now England, Julia's original country. 

Along the way we've raised our son, Eren, across the cultures as we've steadily grown this holiday apartment project - our second baby. We see it as a way to find balance in our family life and to always have a home in our best-loved city.  

We understand from our own experiences, what makes a great city-break stay and try our very hardest to deliver it to you in Istanbul. For this we've won i-escape's global Guest Award for 'Best City Apartment' two years running and Tripadvisor's Certificate of Excellence every year from from 2016 to 2022.

We’re also listed in many guidebooks and have been featured in magazines for our interior design “hipstoric” flair. 

Your questions and booking will be handled by us. On arrival, manager Taşkın and friendly team  - with natural Turkish hospitality - will welcome you to your apartment, pass over the keys and explain practicalities and the neighborhood. You'll have as much or as little help as you choose and we're sure you'll soon feel at home in the cosmopolitan and very welcoming local community.

"Life is a balance of holding on and letting go" said Rumi, whose Mevlevihanesi for 'whirling dervishes' is just up the hill from our apartments in Galata. We agree... do you?!

Located in the very heart of Kadıköy,it provides a quiet and hidden getaway from the maddening crowd. See you in Istanbul.
host_about:

You are more than welcome..

name: Old Istanbul view/ bedroom for 3
description:
The space
This room also has a wonderful view and a huge terrace in a double storey flat in the heart of Kadıköy.

Situated on the Anatolian (Asian) side of Istanbul Kadıköy is the biggest district on this side, very close to everything; cinemas, restaurants, bars, churches, mosques, High Streets and local food markets. And my flat is just in the middle of a High Street on 6th floor. When you go upstairs (yes, there is an elevator) you are completely detached from the crowd downstairs and it is such a relief!

The room of this listing consists of a double bed, wardrobe and enough space to store your luggage. There is a real double bed and a sofa which makes the room ideal for families with a kid.
host_about:
I  rent the rooms in  my two-storey flat in the heart of Kadıköy with a splendid view of old İstanbul; namely the classical view of mosques and towers. There are three rooms upstairs overlooking a huge terrace towards the view. Downstairs there are three other rooms; one living room and one study for common use and another comfortable bedroom  and a biggish kitchen as well as the balcony in front of the living room. 
It is a spacious house with plenty of positive energy, sunshine, laughter and good food. Impression from the guests come from the same direciton; they emphasize the view as well as the atmosphere at home. You do not feel that the rooms are prepared for rent, on the contrary, you feel home. 

Apart from being an academic and a sagittarius, I am a good cook, a hospitable landlady  and an open minded intellectual. I like meeting people from different cultures and adding values to my life. 
 
You are more than welcome..

name: Artists' Oasis
description: Artists’ Oasis is a cozy spacious 2-bedroom 1 bathroom apartment in the heart of Taksim, just steps from Taksim Square and İstiklal Avenue. This true "home away from home" is owned by an artist couple and filled with their personal artwork and handwoven carpets, creating a warm, bohemian atmosphere. The apartment offers an authentic, lived-in feel, perfect for those seeking a genuine, artistic experience in Istanbul—more like staying in a friend’s home than a typical tourist rental.
host_about:
Hi everyone!I am Azadeh, I live in the beautiful city of Istanbul with my husband, Murat. We are both artists.
I have been living in Istanbul for nearly 12 years and enjoy living here so much. We are easy-going and love to know people from other countries. We speak English, Persian and Turkish pretty good.
Our house is located in Beyoğlu. It’s considered as one of the original apartment buildings in the area. It’s around 150 years old, fully furnished with 2 bedrooms and a nice hall with high ceilings. In each bedroom there’s a double sized bed and a closet. The flat is about 100 m2 and includes all the things that you are going to need during your stay including washing machine, a dish washer, fridge, oven and unlimited wireless internet access. The apartment is in the second floor.
As you may already see in the map, the house is located in one of most touristic areas in Istanbul. You will have access to all of the sight-seeings pretty fast from there.If you walk 5 minutes you will get to Taksim Sqaure (which leads to ferries, metro, tram, bus) or Istiklal Avenue which is full of shops, restaurants, grocery, cinemas, theater, opera, night clubs, yoga, gym, shopping center. Funicular
access, from Taksim Square, to the ferries will take you to the Asian side in less than an hour. There are so many restaurants and cafes around the area, so you won't have any problems finding a nice place to hang out. There are also couple of super markets nearby.
From the other direction, five minutes walk, you can explore small antique shops sit next to boutique cafes in the heart of Cihangir, the home of Istanbul's cultural scene and you are headed straight to the harbor passing the Istanbul Modern on the way to the port of Karaköy.
10 minutes by taxi to Historical Peninsula. Looking forward for hosting you in this beautiful and private apartment in the center of it all!

host_about:
We specialise in historic apartments with interior design magic that make memorable, comfortable, secure, short term homes for discerning international visitors - you!

Julia, Tarkan and our manager Taşkın are certified by the UK Institute of Hospitality.

20 years ago we met in Istanbul, Tarkan's home city, while Julia was there for a photography assignment. Since then we've led international lives together, based in Istanbul, Singapore and now England, Julia's original country.

For this we've won i-escape's global Guest Award for 'Best City Apartment' two years running and Tripadvisor's Certificate of Excellence every year from from 2016 to 2022.

We’re also listed in many guidebooks and have been featured in magazines for our interior design “hipstoric” flair.

On arrival, manager Taşkın and friendly team  - with natural Turkish hospitality - will welcome you to your apartment, pass over the keys and explain practicalities and the neighborhood. You'll have as much or as little help as you choose and we're sure you'll soon feel at home in the cosmopolitan and very welcoming local community.

host_about:
I love Istanbul and I feel I am so lucky to live in this beautiful city. It is full of everything: history; Roman, Byzantium, Ottoman,  great food, modernism, orientalism, old, new, nature, full of culture,  surrounded by water ( Golden Horn,  Bosporus,  Marmara sea), seagulls, cats, dogs,  Asia and Europe, architecture,  churches, mosques, mosaics, insightful museums, bazaars and more...
My family moved from Isparta which is south of Turkey to Istanbul about 23 years ago and my parents opened this guesthouse. My dad was just a lorry driver but he opened a guesthouse without any English or experience. He was so brave! I was a kid but loved to grow up with tourists in our house.
Now we have this great place in a great location and great sea view with great guests from all over the world and this is just my life now.
I have graduated from Istanbul University with a degree in Business Administration and as a student discovered our beautiful nature when I had joined a climbing club at Istanbul University. Climbing then became a hobby for me.
Aside from mountain climbing, I also go canyoning, caving (there are lots of caves waiting to be discovered in Turkey), scuba diving and try to see other parts of the world.
I think growing up among tourists has given me the culture of traveling. Not only is Istanbul beautiful, our world is so beautiful and so colorful and we must see every single part of our great world before we die.
In short:
I cannot live without Istanbul!
I cannot live without traveling!
I cannot live without mountains, caves, nature, animals!
I cannot live without my family!
And I cannot live without my Marmara Guesthouse!

I have graduated from Istanbul University with a degree in Business Administration and as a student discovered our beautiful nature when I had joined a climbing club at Istanbul University. Climbing then became a hobby for me.
Aside from mountain climbing, I also go canyoning, caving (there are lots of caves waiting to be discovered in Turkey), scuba diving and try to see other parts of the world.
I think growing up among tourists has given me the culture of traveling. Not only is Istanbul beautiful, our world is so beautiful and so colorful and we must see every single part of our great world before we die.
In short:
I cannot live without Istanbul!
I cannot live without traveling!
I cannot live without mountains, caves, nature, animals!
I cannot live without my family!
And I cannot live without my Marmara Guesthouse!

name: Newly renovated in Galata, with terrace views!
description:
Our apartment is on the 3rd floor of a grand and elegant 19th Century building very close to Galata Tower. It's characterful, graceful and homely, with stunning views right across the Golden Horn from the shared roof terrace a few floors up.

We also offer a selection of 'experiences' with our local guides, to help you build your own genuine and memorable perspective on the city.
host_about:
We specialise in historic apartments with interior design magic that make memorable, comfortable, secure, short term homes for discerning international visitors - you!

Julia, Tarkan and our manager Taşkın are certified by the UK Institute of Hospitality.

We've been busy, building up a special collection of the best apartments in Galata, our favourite part of Istanbul. We've personally renovated most of them and stay in them ourselves whenever we can. Recently we've added a sweet property in England's Cotswolds to the mix.

20 years ago we met in Istanbul, Tarkan's home city, while Julia was there for a photography assignment. Since then we've led international lives together, based in Istanbul, Singapore and now England, Julia's original country. 

Along the way we've raised our son, Eren, across the cultures as we've steadily grown this holiday apartment project - our second baby. We see it as a way to find balance in our family life and to always have a home in our best-loved city.  

We understand from our own experiences, what makes a great city-break stay and try our very hardest to deliver it to you in Istanbul. For this we've won i-escape's global Guest Award for 'Best City Apartment' two years running and Tripadvisor's Certificate of Excellence every year from from 2016 to 2022.

We’re also listed in many guidebooks and have been featured in magazines for our interior design “hipstoric” flair. 

Your questions and booking will be handled by us. On arrival, manager Taşkın and friendly team  - with natural Turkish hospitality - will welcome you to your apartment, pass over the keys and explain practicalities and the neighborhood. You'll have as much or as little help as you choose and we're sure you'll soon feel at home in the cosmopolitan and very welcoming local community.

"Life is a balance of holding on and letting go" said Rumi, whose Mevlevihanesi for 'whirling dervishes' is just up the hill from our apartments in Galata. We agree... do you?!

name: ❤❤Watch Asia from Europe on Terrace
description: Comfortable Classic Double Room featuring one 140 cm double bed. With 10 m² of thoughtfully designed space, including the bathroom, this cozy room is perfect for solo travelers or couples looking for a comfortable base while exploring Istanbul. Located just a 5-minute walk from Sultanahmet Square, the hotel also offers a complimentary breakfast with a beautiful sea view.
host_about:
I love Istanbul and I feel I am so lucky to live in this beautiful city. It is full of everything: history; Roman, Byzantium, Ottoman,  great food, modernism, orientalism, old, new, nature, full of culture,  surrounded by water ( Golden Horn,  Bosporus,  Marmara sea), seagulls, cats, dogs,  Asia and Europe, architecture,  churches, mosques, mosaics, insightful museums, bazaars and more...
My family moved from Isparta which is south of Turkey to Istanbul about 23 years ago and my parents opened this guesthouse. My dad was just a lorry driver but he opened a guesthouse without any English or experience. He was so brave! I was a kid but loved to grow up with tourists in our house.
Now we have this great place in a great location and great sea view with great guests from all over the world and this is just my life now.
I have graduated from Istanbul University with a degree in Business Administration and as a student discovered our beautiful nature when I had joined a climbing club at Istanbul University. Climbing then became a hobby for me.
Aside from mountain climbing, I also go canyoning, caving (there are lots of caves waiting to be discovered in Turkey), scuba diving and try to see other parts of the world.
I think growing up among tourists has given me the culture of traveling. Not only is Istanbul beautiful, our world is so beautiful and so colorful and we must see every single part of our great world before we die.
In short:
I cannot live without Istanbul!
I cannot live without traveling!
I cannot live without mountains, caves, nature, animals!
I cannot live without my family!
And I cannot live without my Marmara Guesthouse!

name: Watch Asia from Europe on Terrace❤❤
description: Comfortable upper-floor room featuring one 140 cm double bed and one 90 cm single bed. Offering 15 m² of space, including the bathroom, this cozy and practical room is ideal for couples, friends, or small families. Located just a 5-minute walk from Sultanahmet Square, the hotel also offers a complimentary breakfast with a beautiful sea view.
host_about:
I love Istanbul and I feel I am so lucky to live in this beautiful city. It is full of everything: history; Roman, Byzantium, Ottoman,  great food, modernism, orientalism, old, new, nature, full of culture,  surrounded by water ( Golden Horn,  Bosporus,  Marmara sea), seagulls, cats, dogs,  Asia and Europe, architecture,  churches, mosques, mosaics, insightful museums, bazaars and more...
My family moved from Isparta which is south of Turkey to Istanbul about 23 years ago and my parents opened this guesthouse. My dad was just a lorry driver but he opened a guesthouse without any English or experience. He was so brave! I was a kid but loved to grow up with tourists in our house.
Now we have this great place in a great location and great sea view with great guests from all over the world and this is just my life now.
I have graduated from Istanbul University with a degree in Business Administration and as a student discovered our beautiful nature when I had joined a climbing club at Istanbul University. Climbing then became a hobby for me.
Aside from mountain climbing, I also go canyoning, caving (there are lots of caves waiting to be discovered in Turkey), scuba diving and try to see other parts of the world.
I think growing up among tourists has given me the culture of traveling. Not only is Istanbul beautiful, our world is so beautiful and so colorful and we must see every single part of our great world before we die.
In short:
I cannot live without Istanbul!
I cannot live without traveling!
I cannot live without mountains, caves, nature, animals!
I cannot live without my family!
And I cannot live without my Marmara Guesthouse!

name: Meroddi Pera Flats - İki Yatak Odalı Daire
description: Pera Flats offers bright and convenient apartments in the heart of Beyoğlu. All apartments have fully equipped kitchens, spacious living spaces, and are suitable for short or long-term stays. Galata Tower, Istiklal Street, cafes and shopping centers are within walking distance. Daily cleaning, 24/7 reception, elevator and free Wi-Fi are available. Our hotel is a historical building known as “Maison Madeleny” in 1891, reflecting the deep-rooted history of Beyoğlu and renovated with today's understanding of comfort.
host_about:
Meroddi Otelleri ve Daireleri, Galata tarihini korumaya çalışan büyük bir butik otel grubudur. Galata'da sadece otel ve dairelerimiz değil, aynı zamanda kafe ve restoranlarımız da mevcut.

Eski, tarihi binaları yeniliyoruz ve 100 yıl önce göründükleri gibi yapmaya çalışıyoruz. Uzun zaman alıyor ve oldukça pahalı ama bu binayı kendi tarihine dönüştürdüğümüzü biliyoruz.

Konaklamanız sırasında ekibimiz her zaman hizmetinizdedir. 

Şaşırtıcı bir konaklama deneyimi yaşatmak için hazırız.  İlk sürpriz, yönetimimiz tarafından tasarlanıp yazılan bir Galata Kitapçığı'dır. Bu kitap, öyküleriyle birlikte en önemli 100 tarihi eseri içeriyor. Ayrıca her binamızın büyülü hikayeleri var ve bu hikayeleri Galata Rehber Kitapçığımızda bulabilirsiniz. Kitabın pdf versiyonunu resepsiyonlarımızdan talep edebilirisniz.

Otelimize ilk geldiğinizde giriş kaydı işlemi için doğrudan resepsiyonumuza gitmeniz gerekir. Tüm giriş işlemleri tamamlandıktan sonra, görevli size odanızı veya dairenizi gösterecektir. 

Ek binalar da vardır. Tüm giriş işlemlerinden sonra, görevli ek binada da size yardımcı olabilir. 

Özel bir isteğiniz olursa lütfen bize bildirmekten çekinmeyin. Konaklamanız sırasında ekibimiz hizmetinizdedir!

Sizinle tanışmak için sabırsızlanıyoruz!


Meroddi Otelleri ve Daireleri


Meroddi Hotels and Apartments

Meroddi Hotels and Apartments is a large group of boutique hotels trying to preserve the history of Galata. In Galata, we have not only hotels and apartments, but also cafes and restaurants.

We are renovating old, historic buildings and trying to make them look like they were 100 years ago. It takes a long time and it's pretty expensive, but we know we've made this building its own history.

Our team is always at your service during your stay.

We are ready to give you an amazing accommodation experience. The first surprise is a Galata Booklet designed and written by our management. This book contains the 100 most important historical works along with their stories. In addition, each of our buildings has magical stories and you can find these stories in our Galata Guide Book. You can request the pdf version of the book from our reception.

When you first arrive at our hotel, you need to go directly to our reception for check-in registration. After all check-in procedures are completed, the attendant will show you your room or apartment.

There are also additional buildings. After all check-in, the attendant can also assist you in the annex building.

If you have a special request, please feel free to let us know. Our team is at your service during your stay!

We look forward to meeting you!


Meroddi Hotels and Apartments

name: Brand New Renovation right next to Galata Tower!
description: Our apartment is on the third floor - three flights of original marble stairs - of a grand 19th-century building with lion motifs, right next to the beautiful Galata Tower. From some windows, you feel you can reach out and touch the tower. The living room overlooks the lively pedestrianised square below, while the kitchen and one bedroom have glimpses across the Golden Horn.
host_about:
We specialise in historic apartments with interior design magic that make memorable, comfortable, secure, short term homes for discerning international visitors - you!

Julia, Tarkan and our manager Taşkın are certified by the UK Institute of Hospitality.

We've been busy, building up a special collection of the best apartments in Galata, our favourite part of Istanbul. We've personally renovated most of them and stay in them ourselves whenever we can. Recently we've added a sweet property in England's Cotswolds to the mix.

20 years ago we met in Istanbul, Tarkan's home city, while Julia was there for a photography assignment. Since then we've led international lives together, based in Istanbul, Singapore and now England, Julia's original country. 

Along the way we've raised our son, Eren, across the cultures as we've steadily grown this holiday apartment project - our second baby. We see it as a way to find balance in our family life and to always have a home in our best-loved city.  

We understand from our own experiences, what makes a great city-break stay and try our very hardest to deliver it to you in Istanbul. For this we've won i-escape's global Guest Award for 'Best City Apartment' two years running and Tripadvisor's Certificate of Excellence every year from from 2016 to 2022.

We’re also listed in many guidebooks and have been featured in magazines for our interior design “hipstoric” flair. 

Your questions and booking will be handled by us. On arrival, manager Taşkın and friendly team  - with natural Turkish hospitality - will welcome you to your apartment, pass over the keys and explain practicalities and the neighborhood. You'll have as much or as little help as you choose and we're sure you'll soon feel at home in the cosmopolitan and very welcoming local community.

"Life is a balance of holding on and letting go" said Rumi, whose Mevlevihanesi for 'whirling dervishes' is just up the hill from our apartments in Galata. We agree... do you?!

 If you want a late check out, the answer is always yes if the next guest is not coming by regular check in time.

Enjoy Istanbul and I hope you leave with good memories and would like to come back again.

description: A first-floor apartment in Sami Bey Apartmanı, built in the 1950s by my grandfather Dr. Zülfü Sami Özgen. host_about:

host_about: I love Istanbul and I feel I am so lucky to live in this beautiful city. It is full of everything: history; Roman, Byzantium, Ottoman, great food, modernism, orientalism, old, new, nature, full of culture, surrounded by water ( Golden Horn, Bosphorus, Marmara sea), seagulls, cats, dogs, Asia and Europe, architecture, churches, mosques, mosaics, insightful museums, bazaars and more... My family moved from Isparta which is south of Turkey to Istanbul about 23 years ago. My dad was just a lorry driver but he opened Marmara Guesthouse without any English or experience. He was so brave! I was a kid but loved to grow up with tourists in our house. We recently opened Masif House as well.I have graduated from Istanbul University with a degree in Business Administration and as a student discovered our beautiful nature when I had joined a climbing club at Istanbul University. Climbing then became a hobby for me. Aside from mountain climbing, I also go canyoning, caving (there are lots of caves waiting to be discovered in Turkey), scuba diving and try to see other parts of the world. I think growing up among tourists has given me the culture of traveling. Not only is Istanbul beautiful, our world is so beautiful and so colorful and we must see every single part of our great world before we die. In short: I cannot live without Istanbul! I cannot live without traveling! I cannot live without mountains, caves, nature, animals! I cannot live without my family!

description: Masif House is small authentic charming white wooden house in Istanbul run by a Turkish family. we will be happy to see you in Istanbul.
host_about: I love Istanbul and I feel I am so lucky to live in this beautiful city. It is full of everything: history; Roman, Byzantium, Ottoman, great food, modernism, orientalism, old, new, nature, full of culture, surrounded by water ( Golden Horn, Bosphorus, Marmara sea), seagulls, cats, dogs, Asia and Europe, architecture, churches, mosques, mosaics, insightful museums, bazaars and more... My family moved from Isparta which is south of Turkey to Istanbul about 23 years ago. My dad was just a lorry driver but he opened Marmara Guesthouse without any English or experience. He was so brave! I was a kid but loved to grow up with tourists in our house. We recently opened Masif House as well.I have graduated from Istanbul University with a degree in Business Administration and as a student discovered our beautiful nature when I had joined a climbing club at Istanbul University. Climbing then became a hobby for me. Aside from mountain climbing, I also go canyoning, caving (there are lots of caves waiting to be discovered in Turkey), scuba diving and try to see other parts of the world. I think growing up among tourists has given me the culture of traveling. Not only is Istanbul beautiful, our world is so beautiful and so colorful and we must see every single part of our great world before we die. In short: I cannot live without Istanbul! I cannot live without traveling! I cannot live without mountains, caves, nature, animals! I cannot live without my family!

Just Hosting

We are delighted to have you as our guests and we want to make sure that your stay with us is both comfortable and memorable.

Just hosting is about being a local angel and helping our guests, inspired by the Turkish tradition of hospitality. We aim to provide you with an experience that feels like you are staying with a good friend.

Here's what you can expect from your stay with us:

-You are only charged for your stay
-Clean and tidy rooms

-Special deals and good service from local businesses

-Tea and conversation about anything in a historic building, with an option to order Pide (this is a dish similar to pizza)
-A food adventure (based on request and availability)
- A ride on the tram along Golden Horn and a visit to Pierre Loti Hill for a stunning view of Golden Horn
-A ferry ride to Uskudar to watch the sunset

In terms of the listings, here's what you can expect:

-Unique, 200-year-old building with unique studio houses and their private  bathrooms
-A beautiful balcony with sea view for everyone to enjoy
-Centrally located and easily accessible by ferry, tram, metro, and bus
-Truly unique homes and hosting experience

host_about:
Welcome to my Airbnb profile! I'm delighted to introduce myself as your host and invite you to my cozy and spacious duplex apartment.

My name is Mina, and I'm a dedicated and friendly host who enjoys welcoming travelers from around the world. As a frequent traveler myself, I understand the importance of a comfortable and convenient stay, and I strive to provide my guests with just that.

My apartment is a four-bedroom duplex with two bathrooms, situated in a peaceful and tranquil neighborhood that is just a short distance away from the vibrant Kadikoy center. The location of my apartment is perfect for guests who value a serene environment but still want to be close to the bustling city center.

Transportation is also easily accessible from my apartment, with public transportation just a stone's throw away. Within the vicinity, there are numerous markets, restaurants, and cafes that cater to different tastes, making it a convenient choice for guests who prefer to explore the local culture.

Whether you're traveling with family, friends, or solo, my apartment is an ideal choice for a memorable stay. I look forward to welcoming you and making your stay as comfortable and enjoyable as possible.

In addition to my passion for hosting, I am also an animal lover and proud owner of a rescued dog. My furry friend is a lovable companion who enjoys spending time with guests, especially those who share the same affection for dogs.

A magical way to experience Istanbul, with million-dollar city-scape views from your private and spacious terrace, bedroom and living room. This is a very special penthouse on the 5th floor of an elegant 19th Century apartment building near Galata Tower.

Furnished with a balance of classy antiques and contemporary designer pieces, it's style-meets-substance . You'll be a resident of the most sophisticated street in this bohemian area, with its boutiques, cafes and restaurants only steps away.
host_about:
We specialise in historic apartments with interior design magic that make memorable, comfortable, secure, short term homes for discerning international visitors - you!

Julia, Tarkan and our manager Taşkın are certified by the UK Institute of Hospitality.

We've been busy, building up a special collection of the best apartments in Galata, our favourite part of Istanbul. We've personally renovated most of them and stay in them ourselves whenever we can. Recently we've added a sweet property in England's Cotswolds to the mix.

20 years ago we met in Istanbul, Tarkan's home city, while Julia was there for a photography assignment. Since then we've led international lives together, based in Istanbul, Singapore and now England, Julia's original country. 

Along the way we've raised our son, Eren, across the cultures as we've steadily grown this holiday apartment project - our second baby. We see it as a way to find balance in our family life and to always have a home in our best-loved city.  

We understand from our own experiences, what makes a great city-break stay and try our very hardest to deliver it to you in Istanbul. For this we've won i-escape's global Guest Award for 'Best City Apartment' two years running and Tripadvisor's Certificate of Excellence every year from from 2016 to 2022.

We’re also listed in many guidebooks and have been featured in magazines for our interior design “hipstoric” flair. 

Your questions and booking will be handled by us. On arrival, manager Taşkın and friendly team  - with natural Turkish hospitality - will welcome you to your apartment, pass over the keys and explain practicalities and the neighborhood. You'll have as much or as little help as you choose and we're sure you'll soon feel at home in the cosmopolitan and very welcoming local community.

"Life is a balance of holding on and letting go" said Rumi, whose Mevlevihanesi for 'whirling dervishes' is just up the hill from our apartments in Galata. We agree... do you?!

We love this quote from Auguste Escoffier, known as “the king of chefs and the chef of kings, “Good food is the foundation of genuine happiness.”. 

Therefore, we always search for local tastes, secret locations when travelling. If you are so, we will be glad to share lovely restaurants and secret places of Istanbul with you.

As Karay House, we provide newly renovated flats in a monumental building, fully equipped, centrally located, tastefully decorated, close to lots of good restaurants, ideal for your short term stays in Galata.

All our flats are one bedroom, modern, stylish and elegant. 

Looking forward to meeting you!

description: A much-loved, stylish apartment on the 2nd floor of a grand 19th century building near Galata Tower. Cosy and atmospheric with exceptional interior design. host_about:
We specialise in historic apartments with interior design magic that make memorable, comfortable, secure, short term homes for discerning international visitors - you!

Julia, Tarkan and our manager Taşkın are certified by the UK Institute of Hospitality.

We've been busy, building up a special collection of the best apartments in Galata, our favourite part of Istanbul. We've personally renovated most of them and stay in them ourselves whenever we can. Recently we've added a sweet property in England's Cotswolds to the mix.

20 years ago we met in Istanbul, Tarkan's home city, while Julia was there for a photography assignment. Since then we've led international lives together, based in Istanbul, Singapore and now England, Julia's original country. 

Along the way we've raised our son, Eren, across the cultures as we've steadily grown this holiday apartment project - our second baby. We see it as a way to find balance in our family life and to always have a home in our best-loved city.  

We understand from our own experiences, what makes a great city-break stay and try our very hardest to deliver it to you in Istanbul. For this we've won i-escape's global Guest Award for 'Best City Apartment' two years running and Tripadvisor's Certificate of Excellence every year from from 2016 to 2022.

We’re also listed in many guidebooks and have been featured in magazines for our interior design “hipstoric” flair. 

Your questions and booking will be handled by us. On arrival, manager Taşkın and friendly team  - with natural Turkish hospitality - will welcome you to your apartment, pass over the keys and explain practicalities and the neighborhood. You'll have as much or as little help as you choose and we're sure you'll soon feel at home in the cosmopolitan and very welcoming local community.

"Life is a balance of holding on and letting go" said Rumi, whose Mevlevihanesi for 'whirling dervishes' is just up the hill from our apartments in Galata. We agree... do you?!

name: Cosy Charm & Breathtaking Terrace Views
description:
Discover our cosy ground-floor apartment in a historic building near Galata Tower. Homely, inviting, and close to local sights, it includes access to a communal rooftop terrace with wonderful Golden Horn and Bosphorus views

This is our newest apartment and we've got excellent reviews for the other four apartments we have at the same building.

A few floors up on the roof-top, a shared terrace has gorgeous views across Golden Horn to the Old City.
host_about:
We specialise in historic apartments with interior design magic that make memorable, comfortable, secure, short term homes for discerning international visitors - you!

Julia, Tarkan and our manager Taşkın are certified by the UK Institute of Hospitality.

We've been busy, building up a special collection of the best apartments in Galata, our favourite part of Istanbul. We've personally renovated most of them and stay in them ourselves whenever we can. Recently we've added a sweet property in England's Cotswolds to the mix.

20 years ago we met in Istanbul, Tarkan's home city, while Julia was there for a photography assignment. Since then we've led international lives together, based in Istanbul, Singapore and now England, Julia's original country. 

Along the way we've raised our son, Eren, across the cultures as we've steadily grown this holiday apartment project - our second baby. We see it as a way to find balance in our family life and to always have a home in our best-loved city.  

We understand from our own experiences, what makes a great city-break stay and try our very hardest to deliver it to you in Istanbul. For this we've won i-escape's global Guest Award for 'Best City Apartment' two years running and Tripadvisor's Certificate of Excellence every year from from 2016 to 2022.

With exposed brick walls, high ceilings, tall windows, 2 queen bedrooms, an ensuite, walk in wardrobe, wetroom, separate WC, smart projector, and a communal rooftop terrace only one floor above with partial Golden Horn views, it offers a calm and comfortable base in one of Istanbul's most atmospheric neighbourhoods, on a quiet street with lovely cafes nearby.
host_about:
We specialise in historic apartments with interior design magic that make memorable, comfortable, secure, short term homes for discerning international visitors - you!

Julia, Tarkan and our manager Taşkın are certified by the UK Institute of Hospitality.

We've been busy, building up a special collection of the best apartments in Galata, our favourite part of Istanbul. We've personally renovated most of them and stay in them ourselves whenever we can. Recently we've added a sweet property in England's Cotswolds to the mix.

20 years ago we met in Istanbul, Tarkan's home city, while Julia was there for a photography assignment. Since then we've led international lives together, based in Istanbul, Singapore and now England, Julia's original country. 

Along the way we've raised our son, Eren, across the cultures as we've steadily grown this holiday apartment project - our second baby. We see it as a way to find balance in our family life and to always have a home in our best-loved city.  

We understand from our own experiences, what makes a great city-break stay and try our very hardest to deliver it to you in Istanbul. For this we've won i-escape's global Guest Award for 'Best City Apartment' two years running and Tripadvisor's Certificate of Excellence every year from from 2016 to 2022.

We’re also listed in many guidebooks and have been featured in magazines for our interior design “hipstoric” flair. 

Your questions and booking will be handled by us. On arrival, manager Taşkın and friendly team  - with natural Turkish hospitality - will welcome you to your apartment, pass over the keys and explain practicalities and the neighborhood. You'll have as much or as little help as you choose and we're sure you'll soon feel at home in the cosmopolitan and very welcoming local community.

"Life is a balance of holding on and letting go" said Rumi, whose Mevlevihanesi for 'whirling dervishes' is just up the hill from our apartments in Galata. We agree... do you?!
